title: Retail / Checkout zone presence - sanity pack (reduced scope)
purpose: M0 sanity scenario, updated at M1. One real retail clip, one pinned detector, the annotated detection fixture, and the clips a presenter can switch between. M1 delivered the ROI geometry and event state machine: app/engine/retail_config.py ships COUNTER_BAND and a people-in-zone presence event. NO product-transfer event is detectable on this footage - the only reliably tracked product is stationary in the basket for the entire clip.

roi.name: counter_band
roi.source: app/engine/retail_config.py COUNTER_BAND, derived from a measured centroid histogram
roi.measured: captures 65.1% of person detections inside, 34.9% outside (cy 0.034..0.864)

roi_note: Normalized ROIs shipped at M1 in app/engine/retail_config.py (COUNTER_BAND), not here, to keep the asset manifest describing assets rather than engine configuration. M0 annotates a single fixed frame instead, in tests/fixtures/retail_sanity/retail_sanity.json - that file exists and is committed, together with its JPEG.

event_annotations.definition: a tracked person whose centroid is inside counter_band for at least min_presence_seconds
event_annotations.measured: 2 events over the clip = two sustained presences, one per person-track; NOT a people count and NOT a dwell measurement, as the event carries no duration
event_annotations.guard: tests/test_retail_footage_guard.py fails if a shipped config emits zero events

content_gate.spec_requirement: three 45-90 second clips per scenario pack
content_gate.note: Clip count for this pack is met at three; the duration band is not. Only store_aisle_alt (65.41535 s) lies inside 45-90 s. retail_checkout (113.0129 s) and queue_alt (139.4 s) are longer than the band. Durations are cv2.VideoCapture measurements of the copied files, not rounded or trimmed. Carried to Task 9 as a declared unmet gate.
